annotations.title: Kiedy i gdzie gra wykonawca / Artist tour dates

description: Kiedy i gdzie zagra ten wykonawca w Polsce? Wszystkie nadchodzące terminy jednego wykonawcy z KiedyKoncert.pl. / When and where does this artist play in Poland? All upcoming concert dates of one artist or band listed on KiedyKoncert.pl, with the artist page link and each concert page link. Typos are tolerated; if the name is ambiguous, candidates are returned.

artist.description: Artist or band name, e.g. "Dawid Kwiatkowski". / Nazwa wykonawcy.

name: artist_tour

browse_url.description: KiedyKoncert.pl page to browse (full list, also when nothing was found).

distance_km.description: Distance from the searched locality; null = in the locality itself.

other_times.description: Further shows of the same event that day.

price_label.description: Price in Polish, e.g. "od 99 zł", or a note such as "Sprawdź cenę u sprzedawcy".

time.description: HH:MM; start time if known (see time_kind).

time_kind.description: start = stage time; doors_only = only doors opening is known; source_unspecified = the source gives one time without saying if it is doors or start.

url.description: Concert page on kiedykoncert.pl (ticket links and full details are there).

interpreted_as.description: Name used after correcting a typo.

note.description: Guidance for answering, e.g. when nothing was found.

search_hint.description: Where to look on KiedyKoncert.pl when nothing matched.
